Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent

Class UniqueIds

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.UniqueIds
public final class UniqueIds extends Object
Generates the unique string keys of UniqueIdKind.UUID and UniqueIdKind.ULID models: version 7 UUIDs and ULIDs, both in lower case as Laravel writes them.

Both start with the milliseconds since the epoch, so ids sort roughly by creation time. Ids made in the same millisecond are ordered by their random part, not by creation. Safe to share across threads when the random source is, as SecureRandom is.
